hostname rt-l01
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
 lifetime 28800
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-ra address 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode transport
!
crypto dynamic-map DYN-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10 10
 set transform-set TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
!
crypto map CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0 10 ipsec-isakmp dynamic DYN-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10
!
vpdn enable
!
bba-group pppoe lac-sample
 virtual-template 2
!
vpdn-group lac-sample
 request-dialin
  protocol l2tp
  domain example.com
 initiate-to ip 198.51.100.1
 l2tp tunnel password dummy-l2tp-secret-c
!
vpdn-group lns-sample
 accept-dialin
  protocol l2tp
  virtual-template 1
 no l2tp tunnel authentication
!
ip local pool l2tp-lns-sample 192.0.2.131 192.0.2.190
!
username example-user password 0 dummy-l2tp-user-secret-1
username sample-user password 0 dummy-l2tp-user-secret-2
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample-wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.252
 crypto map CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-access
 ip address 198.51.100.129 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1.1
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 pppoe enable group lac-sample
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 192.0.2.129 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface Virtual-Template1
 ip unnumbered Loopback0
 peer default ip address pool l2tp-lns-sample
 ppp authentication chap
 ppp ipcp dns 192.0.2.53 192.0.2.54
 no shutdown
!
interface Virtual-Template2
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.10 1
!
end
